T-2954: an open card holds the visitor; tour teaches select, release, Move, Settings

Opening a building card frees the pointer, stops walking and looking from the
keyboard and puts focus on the card. Esc (once), the card's Close, or a click or
tap on the scene releases it. Close is a labelled key with an Esc keycap, pinned
while the card scrolls, 44 px on touch.

The Field Check drops the Confidence view and Go deeper steps: Navigator, look,
walk, select, release, Move, Settings, ready. Bubbles say click or tap by input.

T-2825 (part 2): building cards, people, plants and wildlife in plain words — the reader's overlay (#1127)

* T-2825: research records read in plain words (liberties, ground, open questions, Shops & work)

The owner, 2026-10-18: rewrite the records so a person never reads an internal
ticket number or record id, in any mode. docs/LIBERTIES.md stays append-only and
untouched; the rewrite happens at each compile step, by one shared rule.

- tools/readable_text.py: the rule. A ticket that was a label is dropped; one in
  the sentence becomes "this/earlier/later/other work"; every ticket is kept as
  `work_refs` beside the text, for Researcher mode's link. A record id becomes
  the thing's own name (building, source title by Inspect's T-2644 rule,
  household, person, firm, Wright block number, liberty title); a file path
  becomes what the file is. Self-test in check.sh.
- compile_liberties.py: all 624 entries rewritten; `Ticket:` fields move to
  work_refs; `names` carries every subject/covers building's name. The list no
  longer prints the entry id or the gate's covers token as text.
- compile_scene.py: the ground claims and the exclusions/open questions
  sidecars, at the fields their renderers print; open questions name their
  claim and research note in words.
- compile_businesses.py: location basis/limit_reason; the four civic Go to
  notes reworded at their authored source (allowlist entry removed).
- check_visitor_ui.py: new `records` surface over all of the above; the
  Researcher-mode exemption narrowed to refuse ticket numbers and record ids.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FzSToiEH438nHSwcRUwQAH

* T-2825: order book, population, census, completion audit and source detail in plain words

- build_order_book_1835.py / audit_town_completion_1835.py: the sentences the
  card prints are rewritten at build time; work orders (owning_ticket etc.)
  are untouched data. js/orderbook.js prints no ticket column and no bucket
  key, block or lot id; work orders ride as data-work-ref on their row.
- profile_population_1835.py: every section's prose and cells (households
  by name); town_census.py: the City tile's hover text.
- compile_source_use.py: each source file carries `names` (what each use is
  about) and edges a `locator_text`; js/sources.js shows those and the
  attribute a claim path names, never the record id or raw locator.
- js/plants.js no longer prints a zone's record id.
- check_visitor_ui.py `records` covers all of the above (37k strings).
